z_theta_provenance: Per draw: `theta_deg` = finite `theta_star_deg` if available, else `theta_obs_deg` from `launch_angle_obs_deg`; never `phi_star`.
production_latent_note: Broader posterior-bank exports may include e_x, omega_plus, etc. on long draws; the SBI forward simulator stage-z target vector is only Z_TARGET_COLUMNS; nuisance collision quantities are implied by the deterministic decoder.
decoder_context_g_note: Frozen neural models use `g` = G_COLUMNS. The physics decoder enforces a stricter event context dict (e.g. requires release_pos_y for bank contact-time parity); see manifests/physics_decoder_input_contract.json. Do not assume G_COLUMNS alone suffices for decode_bip_from_sample.
